definitions.gloss: the very best; the utmost; optimal
definitions.explanation: The best possible option, effort, or outcome in a given situation. Often used to express doing everything one can or choosing the best course of action.

examples.japanese: これが{最善|さいぜん}の{方法|ほうほう}だと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I think this is the best method.

examples.japanese: {限|かぎ}られた{時間|じかん}の{中|なか}で{最善|さいぜん}の{判断|はんだん}を{下|くだ}さなければならない。
examples.english: You must make the best possible judgment within the limited time available.

notes:
USAGE:
{最善|さいぜん} means "the very best" and is most commonly used in set phrases rather than standing alone. It carries a nuance of making the best of a situation or putting forth maximum effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最善|さいぜん}を{尽|つ}くす (to do one's utmost)
- {最善|さいぜん}の{方法|ほうほう} (the best method)
- {最善|さいぜん}の{策|さく} (the best plan/strategy)
- {最善|さいぜん}の{判断|はんだん} (the best judgment)
- {最善|さいぜん}の{選択|せんたく} (the best choice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最善|さいぜん}: the very best (often implies effort or optimization)
- {最良|さいりょう}: the finest, the best quality
- {最高|さいこう}: the highest, the greatest (broader and more casual)
- ベスト: best (loanword, casual)
